# Variable `FIT_KERNEL_COMP_ALG_EXTENSION`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

File extension corresponding to FIT_KERNEL_COMP_ALG. The default value is set “.gz” by the kernel-uboot class. If you set FIT_KERNEL_COMP_ALG to “lzo”, you may want to set this variable to “.lzo”.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-FIT_KERNEL_COMP_ALG_EXTENSION)
